The rest of the united parish was held by others: Kemeys-Tynte about 162 acres, the Hon. R. H. Clive about 158, the Taff Vale Railway about 60, John Homfray 38, Henry Hollier 38 (as his own occupier), the Revd John Richards 36, the Llandough glebe 33, Miss Turberville 32 (and R. T. The John Williams holding at Great House is entered under Bute as landowner; that entry cuts against Williams ownership and is already in the site's tithe-h3 data. This row adds the non-Bute owners.
